metadata.grain: one source spatial feature returned for the requested district; actual containment is not guaranteed
metadata.unit_notes: Supplied specification does not state the road-length unit or whether rate is a fraction/percentage; preserve raw values without scaling.
metadata.period_note: UpdateDate is a system update date; it does not establish the statistical period of the underlying household counts.
metadata.household_interpretation: ReasonableHouseholdNumbers is only defined as a reasonable household count; it is not verified as an accessible-household count. Do not subtract it from NumberOfHouseholds to infer inaccessible households.
metadata.time_zone_note: Asia/Taipei identifies the requested civil day. Each source timestamp retains its own original UTC offset.
limitations: 來源識別碼不直接與臺北市直接下載 feed 的識別碼關聯。
未知/缺漏不補零；狀態碼原值保留。
